<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a simple series chain of four resistors connecting the terminals A → N_a1 → N_a2 → N_a3 → X1. By subtracting successive measurements we obtain the individual resistor values:
- R1 (A‑N_a1) = 5 Ω
- R2 (N_a1‑N_a2) = 10 Ω
- R3 (N_a2‑N_a3) = 15 Ω
- R4 (N_a3‑X1) = 20 Ω

These values reproduce every given pairwise resistance, confirming the topology.</thought>
